The Chinese characters for Kathleen

As a transliteration, Kathleen is usually written 凯瑟琳 (Kǎi sè lín). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

凯
Kǎi
triumphant, victorious
瑟
sè
a zither (transliteration)
琳
lín
beautiful jade

Origin and meaning

Kathleen comes from Irish and means “pure (form of Katherine)”.

About the name Kathleen

An Irish form of Katherine, common in Ireland and the US.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “pure (form of Katherine)”, a Kathleen calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
